raw.rationale: Fluocinonide is a potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist whose antiproliferative/cytotoxic effects at 2.5 µM are most likely in hematologic lineages, but among the listed solid lineages glucocorticoid sensitivity is best documented in lymphoid/breast and some CNS contexts; PRISM single-dose data for NR3C1 agonists generally show low lineage selectivity, with the strongest (still modest) signals in breast and central_nervous_system and little to none in most epithelial lineages.
